name: Stanley Greaves
note: Sources conflict on residence: Wikipedia/older press say USA; others say Barbados since late 1980s. No own website or Instagram found.

name: Marlon Griffith
note: No own website or Instagram found; Nagoya-based since 2009.

name: David Gumbs
note: No own website or Instagram surfaced. Solo museum show 'From Dust to Gold' at Telfair Museums, Savannah.

name: Guyodo
note: Real name Frantz Jacques; co-founder of the Atis Rezistans collective; one of four artists of the 2006 Freedom Sculpture (Liverpool). No own website or Instagram found.

name: Anna Ruth Henriques
note: Work in The Jewish Museum, New York (The Book of Mechtilde, acquired 1999). Beware: annaruth.net / ar_ruth belong to a different (Finnish) Anna Ruth.

name: Quisqueya Henríquez
note: Died 30 March 2024 (born Havana 1966). Medium: sculpture, photography, sound, installation, video, collage.

name: Gilberto Hernández Ortega
note: Born Baní 21 Dec 1923, died Santo Domingo 23 Oct 1979 (Lowe Museum lists 1924-1978). Shown at Venice Biennale 2024.

name: Jackie Hinkson
note: Donald 'Jackie' Hinkson; studied Paris and Univ. of Alberta; collection on UNESCO T&T Memory of the World Register (2010). No own website or Instagram found; living status not settled.

name: Satch Hoyt
note: Born London to British/African-Jamaican heritage; sculpture, installation with sound, painting, drawing. Website taken from a 2013 blog post, not checked live. No Instagram found.

name: Jean-Marc Hunt
note: Born Strasbourg 1975. Shows: Ti'Punch Molotov (Paris 2021), NEGATALENT (Fondation Clément, Martinique, 2024). No own website or Instagram found.

name: Bendel Hydes
note: Caymanian artist 1952-2024, called the founding father of Caymanian art; retrospective at National Gallery of the Cayman Islands (2019).

name: Marcos Irizarry
note: Born Mayagüez 1936, died San Juan 1995; work in Museo de Arte de Puerto Rico.

name: Deborah Jack
note: Born Sint Maarten; professor of art at New Jersey City University. Handle from her own CV and Esker Foundation profile.

name: Barbara Jardine
note: Trinidadian jeweller (Barbie Jardine), trained at Royal College of Art, returned to Trinidad 1974; Woman Warrior bracelet in V&A collection; subject of documentary The Solitary Alchemist (2009). No own website or Instagram found.

name: Leasho Johnson
note: MFA SAIC; work on view at MCA Chicago per gallery bio. No own website or Instagram found.

name: Jasmin Joseph
note: Haitian painter/sculptor, born Grande Rivière du Nord 1923 (some sources 1924), died 2005.

name: Remy Jungerman
gallery: Goodman Gallery; Fridman Gallery (New York); Galerie Ron Mandos (Amsterdam)
note: Born Moengo, Suriname; represented the Netherlands at the 2019 Venice Biennale; A.H. Heineken Prize for Art 2022. No own website or Instagram found.

name: Patricia Kaersenhout
note: Dutch artist of Surinamese heritage; solo show at CBK Zuidoost 2024. No own website or Instagram found.

name: Kcho
note: Alexis Leiva (Leyva) Machado, born Isla de la Juventud (one source says 1969). Website taken from Wikipedia infobox, not verified live. No Instagram found.

name: Roshini Kempadoo
note: Media artist, photographer and scholar. No Instagram found.

name: Mark King
note: Assumed to be Barbadian artist Mark King (Alice Yard residency 2012, monograph 'Plastic' 2013); website from a T&T Film Festival page. Confirm this is the book's Mark King. Instagram handle truncated in source, not recorded.

name: Yubi Kirindongo
note: Self-taught, born 1946; known for scrap-metal car-part sculptures. No own website or Instagram found.
